source_location: UNRECOVERABLE IN THIS FIELD: the original value was destroyed by a redact_pii.py TOKEN_RE false positive (the regex character class included '/', so the whole absolute path matched as one 32+ character token and was replaced). The source bundle still exists elsewhere; this manifest no longer names it. See redaction_defect below. The sanitized OUTPUT that this manifest describes is intact and verified by sha256.
source_note_text: Earlier private-history commits retain versions without these redactions: e77430b5 (36 one-time codes plus all link tokens), f8321714 and 4b1f2eb2 (Cloudflare email-verification URL token plus link tokens). History was not rewritten.

preserved_by_design.reason: pure-hex digests, all-lowercase slugs and ids of 32+ chars; not credentials, and redacting them would corrupt the dataset.

shareability_statement: This sanitized extract is the ONLY shareable form of this iMessage export; the raw bundle at source_location is do-not-share.
idempotency_evidence: a second run over the output produced byte-identical bytes (cmp IDENTICAL) and 0 credential hits
sanitizer: sanitize_export.py (this directory); phone convention from redact_phones.py, parsed-string-walk convention from redact_pii.py

redaction_defect.what: redact_pii.py replaced source_location, output_path and output_sha256 with <TOKEN-REDACTED>
redaction_defect.why: TOKEN_RE class [A-Za-z0-9+/=_-] included /, so a long absolute path matched as one token; a 64 hex sha256 also matched
redaction_defect.fixed: TOKEN_RE now excludes / and HEX_DIGEST_RE exempts 32-64 hex digests; both restored fields stay readable after re-running
redaction_defect.effect_on_shareability: none: no credential escaped, only provenance metadata was lost
